apps_card_description_manage: See the apps installed in this Workspace, and manage the ones it registered.
apps_card_description_view: See the apps installed in this Workspace and the ones it registered.
apps_admin_only_note: Only Workspace owners and admins can register, edit or remove apps.
apps_installed_empty_description_manage: The apps this Workspace registers are installed here, so its members can sign in to them with CoForge.
apps_installed_empty_description_view: The apps this Workspace’s owners and admins register are installed here.
apps_installed_no_match: No installed app matches these filters
apps_mine_intro_manage: The apps this Workspace registered. Edit one to change its details or how it signs people in.
apps_mine_intro_view: The apps this Workspace registered. Only Workspace owners and admins can change them.
apps_mine_empty_description_manage: Register an app to get its client ID and secret for Login with CoForge.
apps_mine_empty_description_view: Workspace owners and admins register the apps this Workspace uses.
apps_mine_no_match: No registered app matches these filters
apps_no_match_description: Try another search or category, or clear them to see every app.
apps_secret_once: This is the only time it is shown. Copy it now.
apps_section_profile_description: How the app is named and described in this Workspace.
apps_logo_hint_register: Register the app first; you can upload its logo when you edit it.
apps_logo_hint_edit: Upload a square image, or reset to the monogram made from its name.
apps_logo_invalid: Use a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MB.
apps_logo_error: The logo couldn't be changed. Try again.
apps_field_key_hint: Optional. Leave it empty and one is made from the app name.
apps_field_key_fixed_hint: Set when the app was registered; it can't be changed.
apps_field_when_to_use_hint: Shown to Agents. Leave it empty to show nothing.
apps_field_when_to_use_placeholder: When an Agent should reach for this app, in one line
apps_section_login_description: People approve the app when they sign in to it with their CoForge account.
apps_field_redirect_uris_hint: Where people return after signing in: https, or http on localhost. Leave it empty if the app never signs people in.
apps_scope_identity: Who they are in this Workspace
apps_section_danger_description: Changes that can't be taken back.
apps_danger_secret_description: A new secret replaces the current one at once, and is shown only once.
apps_regenerate_description: The current secret for {key} stops working at once. The new one is shown only once.
apps_regenerate_error: Couldn't regenerate the secret. Try again.
apps_danger_delete_description: Removes the app's registration and its credentials for good.
apps_delete_description: This removes the app, its client secret and every approval people gave it. Sign-in with CoForge through {key} stops working. This can't be undone.
apps_delete_error: Couldn't delete the app. Try again.
apps_error_key: Use 3 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter, or leave it empty.
apps_error_key_taken: This client ID is already taken. Choose another, or leave it empty.
apps_error_name: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
apps_error_when_to_use: Use one line of no more than 160 characters before saving.
apps_error_homepage: Enter a full https:// URL, written the way a browser shows it, such as https://example.com/, or leave it empty.
apps_error_redirect_uris: Enter up to 10 different full URLs: https, or http on localhost, with no #fragment.
apps_error_scopes: Keep openid, profile and identity; email is the only optional scope.
apps_error_access_denied: You no longer have permission to change apps.
apps_error_register: Couldn't register the app. Try again.
apps_error_update: Couldn't save the app. Try again.
agent_apps_section_description: Apps this Agent has access to.
agent_apps_grant_description: Choose an app installed in this Workspace to act for this Agent.
agent_apps_grant_no_apps: No apps in this Workspace yet
agent_apps_grant_all_granted: Every app in this Workspace already has access
agent_apps_source_automatic: Granted when the Agent first used it
agent_apps_source_approval: A person approved the Agent's request
agent_apps_empty_description: Apps installed in this Workspace get access the first time this Agent uses them.
agent_apps_grant_no_apps_description: Workspace owners and admins register apps in Settings → Applications.
app_card_denied_reason: Only Workspace owners and admins, or the Agent's creator, can approve this.
